news.title: Kolhapur civic body to regularise pre-2011 residential encroachments
news.para: Kolhapur municipal corporation will regularize residential encroachments made before 2011. Plots up to 500 square feet will be regularized free of cost. Online applications will be accepted from September 7, with special camps. Plots exceeding 1,500 square feet and those on riverbeds are ineligible. Charges will apply for plots between 500 and 1,500 square feet.

news.title: Himachal Pardesh HC expresses concern over illegal multi-storey buildings in Solan hills
news.para: The Himachal Pradesh High Court has raised alarms over unauthorized constructions that threaten the region's ecology. In a call to action, the court has requested comprehensive details from the government regarding these developments. Images reveal significant building activities leading to a stark decline in greenery between 2015 and 2026. The hearing will continue on September 15.

news.title: Greater Noida authority raises farmers’ land aid by ₹2,200 per sq meter ahead of phase-II acquisition
news.para: The Greater Noida Authority recently announced an increase in farmer compensation to Rs 6,415 per square meter. For farmers selecting abadi plots, the compensation is pegged at Rs 5,725 per square meter. This adjustment is designed to facilitate land acquisition for the second phase, covering approximately 40,000 hectares across 140 villages, and is a step towards resolving previous protests from farmers.

news.title: Nagpur civic body seizes properties of tax defaulters in recovery drive
news.para: The Nagpur Municipal Corporation has escalated its property tax collection efforts, resulting in the recovery of Rs 1.51 crore and the seizure of several properties from defaulters. This initiative is part of a broader campaign aiming to recover a staggering Rs 1,000 crore in pending property taxes, targeting primarily commercial properties and major offenders.

news.title: Haryana RERA orders Ansal Phalak Infrastructure to pay 10.8% interest for flat handover delay
news.para: Gurgaon Rera ordered Ansal Phalak Infrastructure to pay delayed possession interest.  Homebuyers booked a flat in Esencia project in Sector 67 over a decade ago.  The developer was to complete construction within 36 months, with a grace period.  The authority computed the prescribed interest rate as 10.8% per annum.  The promoter failed to hand over possession within the stipulated timeline.

news.title: Lucky draws for 8,000 LIG flats in Hyderabad begin; to continue till August 31
news.para: In Hyderabad, the lucky draw for Indiramma Towers flats unfolded in four key constituencies, handing eligible beneficiaries the perk of free registration. Homes can be sold after a decade, marking a significant opportunity for residents. The construction is set to kick off soon, with a target completion within a year.

news.title: LIC Housing Finance appoints Sandeep Kumar as MD & CEO
news.para: LIC Housing Finance has appointed Sandeep Kumar as additional director in the capacity of managing director & CEO and key managerial personnel. His appointment is effective August 29, 2026, for the period of his deputation as LIC of India’s nominee director, subject to a maximum tenure of five years.

news.title: Saudi Arabia's New Murabba replaces chief executive
news.para: New Murabba, a Saudi gigaproject developer, has appointed a new acting chief executive. This leadership change signals adjustments to the kingdom's economic transformation plan. The colossal cube-shaped skyscraper project is now slated for completion by 2040. Some ambitious projects face scaling back due to financial pressures and oil prices.

news.title: Enforcement directorate freezes bank deposits worth ₹51.75 crore in DHFL case
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has taken significant measures by freezing bank deposits exceeding fifty-one crore rupees as part of an ongoing inquiry into extensive bank loan fraud. This case pertains to Dewan Housing Finance Corporation Limited and its promoters, revealing that a property in the UK was sold off through forged liabilities. A bank account containing over five million US dollars has also been affected by this freeze.

news.title: Tamil Nadu minister announces housing, building approval reforms and financial relief measures
news.para: Tamil Nadu plans to introduce a digital framework for handling land-use change applications, enhancing self-certification capabilities. Local bodies will see their building approval limits raised considerably. Alongside this, the government is committed to renovating outdated housing units and rebuilding worn-out flats. Infrastructure enhancements are also on the agenda for multiple housing projects, accompanied by an interest-waiver initiative to assist borrowers from cooperative housing societies.

news.title: SNN Raj Corp begins controlled demolition of 49 flats at Bengaluru's SNN Raj Etternia
news.para: SNN Raj Corp has initiated a controlled demolition of 49 apartment units at SNN Raj Etternia due to a soil investigation error. This notable reconstruction effort will see Edifice Engineering perform the demolition utilizing cutting-edge safety methods. Expected to wrap up in six months, the project will focus on rebuilding homes while ensuring structural integrity and prioritizing safety over commercial gain.

news.title: Delhi: 24x7 medical help, check-up & cashless treatment for 2.7 lakh construction workers
news.para: Delhi is introducing a comprehensive health scheme aimed at protecting its construction workforce. Under this program, workers will benefit from free yearly check-ups and cashless hospitalisation, backed by mobile first-aid units for on-site care. Coverage for treatments will extend to ten lakh rupees for workers and their families, helping to mitigate health risks and ease financial pressure on this vital labor force.

news.title: Fee cut fails to boost property conversion in Bengaluru under land guarantee
news.para: Authorities hoped to regularise lakhs of properties and earn crores, but poor participation has left the initiative struggling. Ownership disputes and technical hurdles continue to stall the government’s drive. Despite reduced rates and campaigns, only a fraction of property owners sought A‑Khata conversion, leaving civic bodies struggling to meet ambitious revenue expectations

news.title: Pune civic body to conduct special audit of merged areas to recover ₹2,500 crore in property tax
news.para: The Pune Municipal Corporation is set to conduct a thorough audit of property taxes in newly merged areas, with a goal to recover over ₹2,500 crore in outstanding dues. Additionally, a private consultant will design a cutting-edge real-time traffic data management system, integrating diverse data sources to enhance urban mobility. In a notable initiative, the corporation has also sanctioned free birth certificates for all newborn girls.

news.title: Gurugram: Illegal walls blocking roads in Greenwood City demolished
news.para: Authorities took firm action in Greenwood City, Sector 45, demolishing four illegal walls that obstructed local roads and disrupted rainwater drainage. This measure is set to improve the drainage capabilities and reduce the possibility of waterlogging during the impending monsoon. Furthermore, an obstruction caused by an illegal guest house on a service road was eliminated, responding to long-standing waterlogging issues in Gurgaon.

news.title: Gurugram sector 102 residents demand completion of planned 24 meter roads
news.para: Connectivity troubles plague over 500 families living near Emaar Imperial Gardens, as key 24-metre roads remain unfinished for seven years, affecting emergency access. Residents are advocating for priority land acquisition to expedite construction of internal sector roads critical for linking to the Dwarka Expressway and Upper Dwarka Expressway. Additionally, the lack of adequate street lighting on nearby revenue roads heightens safety risks.

news.title: Hyderabad: Consumer panel orders developer of Oyster Blue Elite to return sale deed, pay compensation
news.para: A consumer commission has mandated that a developer return a sale deed to a buyer, alongside financial compensation for litigation expenses. This decision arose from discrepancies over the sale price of two parcels, revealing that the developer displayed inadequate service and engaged in unfair business practices, failing to deliver essential documents and the sale deed.

news.title: Maharashtra issues comprehensive guidelines to expedite recovery of dues; priority to MahaRERA warrants
news.para: The new regulations issued by the state government aim to expedite revenue recovery initiatives. Special attention is given to MahaRERA matters to ensure homebuyers' monetary interests are protected. Officials are tasked with tracking down defaulters' assets through a variety of governmental databases. Any seized properties will undergo auctioning after being publicly announced in the Gazette.
